headlines.title: Pliant raises $80M to open its B2B payments platform to AI agents
Finpilot raises $10M for AI agents that handle the grunt work for institutional investors
Parsec founders raise $8.75M from a16z to give AI agents their own PCs
Aformic raises $6.95M to move its factory robots into AI data centres
Pangram releases Pangram Image 1.0, which it says is state-of-the-art in AI image and AI video detection, and the smaller Image Flash 1.0 for AI video detection (Isaac Kasahara/Pangram)
Ai2 gets $5M from Google to turn AI weather model into a tool for projecting climate change
Uber only fulfilled 4 rides from AI agents last quarter
Adobe puts its marketing AI agent inside ChatGPT, Claude and Copilot
AI inference startup Fal doubles its valuation to $16B as demand surges
China’s Largest Startup Deal Ever Lifts Global Venture Funding To $59B In October
Y Combinator’s Garry Tan uses AI agents so much, he spends up to $200K a year on tokens
Trajectory raises $45M to make AI model training accessible to nontechnical experts
Nothing teases a screen-free AI device ahead of launch next month
Shares of US tech giants jump after Democrats' midterm sweep as investors bet that a Democrat-controlled Congress will slow AI capex that's draining cash flow (Bloomberg)
Sequoia raised ~$10B in new funds, and announces it is shutting down its Arc accelerator and Scouts program, merging its early-stage and growth teams, and more (Connie Loizos/TechCrunch)
Galantas CEO Mario Stifano on AI, data centres and the copper supply gap
Titan OS, which monetizes smart TVs via ads and FAST deals, raised $46M in equity and debt, taking its total funding to $110M, and says it now has 30M users (Ivan Mehta/TechCrunch)
First X-BAT fighter jet prototype unveiled as Shield AI preps Seattle area factory for 2027 launch
Democrats' sweep of Congress raises the likelihood of strong frontier AI legislation passing in early 2027, including mandatory testing and developer liability (Shakeel Hashim/Transformer)
TeraWulf secures a credit backstop agreement with Google to support financing for its data center project with Anthropic in Kentucky, set to come online H2 2027 (Deborah Sophia/Reuters)
Apple opens Siri AI to every app, and plans a fee for expanded use
Crypto and AI super PACs spent $250M in 2026 midterms, but lost 9/12 competitive races called so far, spending $74.7M on losing candidates and $28.3M on winners (Molly White/Citation Needed)
Rover hires Textio co-founder Jensen Harris and former Amazon exec Vik Rajagopal
Tech companies tell job applicants: Be AI-pilled (but not too AI-pilled!)
